subtasks.text: Identify that subsistence farm output is primarily for local requirements with little surplus trade.

tasks.task: Detail the practices and decisions in subsistence farming.

subtasks.text: Explain that planting decisions are made primarily based on the family's needs for the coming year with secondary consideration for market prices.
Quote Tony Waters on the definition of subsistence peasants.

tasks.task: Discuss the contemporary context of subsistence agriculture.

subtasks.text: Mention that today, most subsistence farmers participate in trade but mainly for non-survival goods like sugar, bicycles, and clothing.
Note that the majority of subsistence farmers reside in developing countries and have limited trade in cash.

tasks.task: Outline the historical prominence of subsistence agriculture.

subtasks.text: State that subsistence agriculture was the dominant mode of production until market-based capitalism became widespread.
Mention that subsistence agriculture had largely disappeared in Europe by the beginning of World War I and in North America due to the movement of farmers in the 1930s and 1940s.
